thread:
**Issue #3570 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3570: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S24, Call to Chaos (Mindustrial-Swarm Edition)
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds Call to Chaos (Mindustrial-Swarm Edition) and its two Golems.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP5, SP6, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## Cards

| # | Card |
| --- | --- |
| #142 | Call to Chaos (Mindustrial-Swarm Edition) |
| #142.1 | Mindustrial Golem |
| #142.2 | Swarm Golem |

## What it builds on

- The foundation (#3535): every card's catalog entry, both faces and a stub script.
- Every part its effects name: S01 (#3551, the Paperclip tag), S02 (#3541) and S03 (#3542, evolved Swarm cards), S08 (#3555, GIGA), S13 (#3560, Toxopid), S16 (#3553, Jlockeed), S21 (#3561), S22 (#3569) and S23 (#3539, Terminus and Starships), and through them E2 (Toxic and Burn) and E5 (Replenish).
- Stinkyscape's Call to Chaos cards (S25 of #1856) and Wildar.

## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- The base face draws one effect of the ten at random. The Radiant face ("!!!") draws three distinct ones.
- "Refresh 2 (4) mana" reads Replenish (E5). "Jlockheed" means Jlockeed.
- "Cast 5 Jlockeed cards" draws five random Jlockeed cards, Units included (the owner, 2026-11-09): each Spell is cast with random targets and each Unit (or other permanent) is summoned. The card's text reads "Summon or cast 5 random Jlockeed cards".
- "Add the Toxopid to your hand, it costs (0)" adds #121 Toxopid.
- "For the rest of the game, when you Launch a starship cast a random Call to Chaos, summon a random (2) cost Weapon": a rest-of-game watcher on its caster.
- "Cast a random Call to Chaos" never draws this card again within the same cast.
- #142.1, #142.2: "Stinkscape+" means Stinkyscape+. The Mindustrial Golem summons a random Mindustrial card that can't attack, and the Swarm Golem summons an evolved Swarm card (E1's mark).
- Random cards are unique within each effect (E9).

## The designer's text, verbatim

```text
**(4) Call to Chaos (Mindustrial-Swarm Edition) Spell, Call to Chaos, Stinkyscape+, Legendary, #142**
???
*(One of the following random effects)*

- Add 3 random **Paperclip** cards to your hand, they cost (0), **Refresh 2 mana**
- Add 3 random **Evolved Swarm** cards to your hand, they cost (0)
- Summon two random **Radiant** units, make them **GIGA**
- Cast 5 **Jlockheed** cards
- Add 3 **Terminus** cards to your hand, **Refresh 4 mana**
- Add the **Toxopid** to your hand, it costs (0)
- **Toxic 3** and **Burn 3** all enemies
- For the rest of the game, when you **Launch** a **starship** cast a random **Call to Chaos**, summon a random (2) cost **Weapon**
- Summon a **Mindustrial Golem** and a **Swarm Golem**
- Cast a random **Call to Chaos**

~~~
!!!
*(three effects)*

**(4) Mindustrial Golem Unit, Token, Mindustrial, Stinkscape+, Legendary, #142.1**
5/5
**Rush**
**Ranged**
After this attacks summon a **Random Mindustrial card** that **can’t attack**
~~~
10/10
**Rush**
**Ranged**
After this attacks summon a **Random Radiant Mindustrial card** that **can’t attack**

**(4) Swarm Golem Unit, Token, Mindustrial, Stinkscape+, Legendary, #142.2**
5/5
**Rush**
After this attacks summon a **Swarm** card that is **Evolved**
~~~
10/10
**Rush**
After this attacks summon a **Radiant Swarm** card that is **Evolved**
```

## Done when

- [ ] Every card above plays its base and Radiant faces by its text and the readings, in its own script file (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/cNNN_slug.rs`, the stub the foundation made), with tests for both faces in the same file, one test per effect (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (rule 10).
- [ ] Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9). A script reads state only through the prelude's helpers. A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (CLAUDE.md, Architecture).
- [ ] Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3). The cards' §8 rows say what was built.
- [ ] Every prompt these cards open is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for these cards, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check` and `names --check` pass.
- [ ] Only these cards' catalog entries and §8 rows are edited (other parts edit theirs side by side), and the set stays `Held`: players see nothing until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3551, #3541, #3542, #3555, #3560, #3553, #3561, #3569, #3539

Part of #3534.
````
